what: The kernels the Rust serving engine (ds4-rs-ascend) launches, at the shapes it launches them. Separate from the model corpora because these rows exist for an ENGINE SLOT, not for a model block: rms_norm_512 is here because LAYER0_KERNELS launches it, not because any model has a 512-wide normalisation. The rope row is the engine's `ds4_rope_halves`: 64-wide input split into two 32 halves, one 64-wide output written as two halves -- the shape and formula are the layer0 fixture's.

totals.device_verified_what_it_counts: COUNTS rows in THIS corpus carrying a device_check with no outstanding attribution caveat, of any date. See each of those rows' device_check_tolerance_conflict_2026_11_08. A row here claims `this kernel was observed correct on device`; a campaign `verified` record additionally claims `these exact bytes were, at the campaign's own tolerance`.
